message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes. Facts: Lǐhú (令狐) stole an electric bike, value 2300 yuan, which is relatively large. So theft (盗窃) with relatively large amount. The prosecution says "盗窃他人财物数额较大" => theft. So crime: 盗窃. Also maybe "数额较大" qualifies as theft (盗窃罪). For the second defendant, 蒋某某 bought the stolen bike knowing it's stolen, so crime: 掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪 (concealing/obstructing). So answer should list both: 盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得. In examples they sometimes separate with semicolon. So final answer: [罪名]盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得<eoa>
